tasks.instruction: Use the LinkedIn app to search for a customer service representative position. Select a job, open Keep Notes, create a new note, record the company's name, and set the note's title to 'customer service representative'.
rubrics: Opened LinkedIn app
Searched for customer service representative position
Viewed job details for at least one listing
Opened Keep Notes app
Created a new note
Recorded the company's name in the note
Set the note title to 'customer service representative'
human_reference_operations: tap on one job to view details
tap '+' to create a new note
type company name in note body

tasks.instruction: Using Chrome, search for the date of the next Winter Olympics opening ceremony and then set a reminder for that date in your Calendar.
rubrics: Opened Chrome browser
Searched for the date of the next Winter Olympics opening ceremony
Identified the correct date from the search results
Opened the Calendar app
Created a new reminder or event
Entered the correct date for the Winter Olympics opening ceremony
Saved the reminder or event
human_reference_operations: type 'next Winter Olympics opening ceremony date'
view search results and note the date
tap '+' or 'Create' to add new event/reminder
enter title like 'Winter Olympics Opening Ceremony'
set the date to the one found in search

tasks.instruction: Watch a YouTube video about fitness tracking app recommendations, check the video's description for the suggested apps, then use Google Play Store to download one of the suggested apps.
rubrics: Opened the YouTube app
Searched for fitness tracking app recommendations
Watched a relevant video
Checked the video's description for suggested apps
Identified at least one suggested fitness tracking app
Opened Google Play Store
Searched for and downloaded one of the suggested apps
human_reference_operations: select and play a relevant video
tap on video description or scroll down
note the name of one app
tap on the app from the list

tasks.instruction: Utilize Chrome to research different Recipe Organizer apps, and then proceed to Google Play Store, download one of your choice.
rubrics: Opened Chrome browser
Searched for different Recipe Organizer apps
Reviewed information about at least one Recipe Organizer app
Identified a preferred app from the search results
Opened Google Play Store
Searched for the selected Recipe Organizer app
Downloaded the app

note the name of one preferred app
tap on the app in the results

tasks.instruction: Use the CBC News app to search for Artificial Intelligence news, read an article, share it via Gmail, send to agent.benchmark.2024@gmail.com.
rubrics: Opened the CBC News app
Searched for Artificial Intelligence news
Read at least one article about Artificial Intelligence
Opened Gmail app
Composed a new email
Pasted the article link or shared content
Sent the email to agent.benchmark.2024@gmail.com

tap on 'Compose' to create a new email
paste the article link or content in the email body
